title: Inventory page shows 6 products with names, images, prices, and add-to-cart buttons
steps: Verify each product has image (inventory_item_img), title link (item_{id}_title_link), and add-to-cart button
expected: 6 products visible: Sauce Labs Backpack, Bike Light, Bolt T-Shirt, Fleece Jacket, Onesie, Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red)

title: Sort dropdown has 4 options and defaults to A-Z
steps: Verify default selected option is 'Name (A to Z)'
Verify 4 options: Name (A to Z), Name (Z to A), Price (low to high), Price (high to low)
expected: Sort dropdown works correctly with 4 sort options

title: Add to cart button works and changes to Remove
steps: Verify button reverts to 'Add to cart' and badge disappears
expected: Add/remove toggles correctly; cart badge updates

title: Product detail page loads on title click
steps: Click item_4_title_link for Sauce Labs Backpack

title: Add to cart shows badge and button changes to Remove
steps: Check button text changes to Remove
